privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This document is intended to provide comprehensive legal protection, operational clarity, and user transparency for the APEX HUMAN™ brand, digital infrastructure, coaching systems, educational content, and related services.
privacy.introduction_body: This Privacy Policy governs the collection, use, disclosure, storage, protection, and processing of information by APEX HUMAN™ through the website apexhuman.co, coaching systems, consultations, digital products, applications, questionnaires, payment systems, communications, and related services.
privacy.information_collect_body: We may collect personal information including your full name, email address, phone number, payment details, IP address, browser information, operating system data, device identifiers, account activity, application forms, health and performance questionnaires, communication history, and analytics data.
privacy.health_data_body: Users may voluntarily provide information related to training, recovery, nutrition, sleep, supplementation, hormones, stress management, lifestyle habits, and physical performance. This information is used solely for service personalization and coaching optimization.
privacy.how_use_body: Collected information may be used to deliver coaching services, improve customer experience, personalize recommendations, process transactions, analyze website performance, provide customer support, maintain platform security, communicate updates, and fulfill legal obligations.
privacy.legal_basis_body: Where applicable under GDPR and other privacy regulations, information is processed based on consent, contractual necessity, legitimate business interests, legal compliance, and user-initiated requests.
privacy.cookies_body: APEX HUMAN™ may use cookies, analytics platforms, advertising pixels, behavioral tracking tools, session identifiers, and related technologies to improve website performance, optimize advertising campaigns, and enhance user experience.
privacy.payment_body: Payments may be processed through third-party providers. APEX HUMAN™ does not directly store complete credit card or banking information on its servers.
privacy.third_party_body: Our services may integrate with external platforms including payment processors, scheduling software, CRM systems, analytics providers, communication tools, email platforms, social media services, and cloud-based systems. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party providers.
privacy.security_body: We implement commercially reasonable safeguards designed to protect information from unauthorized access, misuse, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Despite these measures, no online system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.international_body: Information may be processed and stored in jurisdictions outside your country of residence where privacy protections may differ.
privacy.retention_body: Information is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill operational, legal, compliance, accounting, contractual, and legitimate business purposes.
privacy.user_rights_body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or port your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at coach@apexhuman.co.

apply.landing_p3: If you're ready to commit twelve months, fill out the application below.

apply.q1_headline: What's happening with your body, energy, confidence, and overall health right now — honestly?
apply.q1_helper: Be specific. Energy levels, sleep, body composition, mental clarity, confidence. Two to four sentences.
apply.q1_placeholder: Tired by 3 PM. Body doesn't match the work I've put in. Sleep is broken. Confidence isn't what it used to be...
apply.q2_headline: Why do you want to transform? What would that transformation mean for your life and your loved ones — and what happens if nothing changes?
apply.q2_helper: The honest answer. What's at stake — both ways. Be specific about the people who matter.
apply.q2_placeholder: My kids deserve a father who can keep up. My wife deserves a man with energy at the end of the day...
apply.q3_headline: What have you tried over the last few years to improve your health or physique — and why do you think it never fully worked?
apply.q3_helper: Diets, programs, coaches, trainers, supplements, apps. What worked for a few weeks? What collapsed when life got busy?
apply.q3_placeholder: Tried keto for 3 months — lost weight, gained it back. Worked with a trainer 4x/week — couldn't sustain...
apply.q4_headline: If we work together successfully for the next 12 months, what would your body, energy, confidence, and lifestyle look like?
apply.q4_helper: Paint the picture. Energy at the end of the day, body composition, sleep, capability, confidence, freedom. Be specific.
apply.q4_placeholder: Lean in the suit. Energy that lasts the whole day. Sleep that resets the system. Bloodwork in the top 10% for my age...
apply.q5_headline: Apex Human is built around long-term transformation, with a 12-month minimum commitment. Are you ready to begin within the next 30 days?
apply.q5_helper: Be honest. This is the most important question.
apply.q6_headline: What level of monthly investment are you prepared to make toward your health, performance, and longevity?
apply.q6_helper: Pricing is shared on the discovery call — not before. This question helps us understand your seriousness.
apply.no_times: No available times on this date.
apply.confirmed_note: We review every application personally. You'll hear back within 48 hours.
